findings: Published SIAM2020 method has an author-supplied fully connected OpenNetFlat, so no image/text CNN is inherently required; Apache2.0 source license.
Native code uses Python2 syntax and TensorFlow1.3-era contrib/slim APIs; a modern port requires numerical and update-order equivalence evidence.

ii-loss separates class means and compacts classes; optional cross-entropy uses a separate sequential optimizer step. Native global threshold hardcodes the upper1percent TRAIN score even though a contamination argument exists.
Random replacement minibatches missing any class are skipped before optimization; preserving this matters for heavily imbalanced IDS data.
Flat architecture, scaling, loss variant and faithful threshold contract remain unselected; no runtime check or benchmark fit.
